changes: Prepare representable full-batch price thresholds outside the shared worker escrow lock. The common callback chooses exactly the original BATCH fuel and debits using comparisons and shifts; zero prices, overflowing thresholds or limited headroom retain the original divisions.
Pricing errors remain deferred until the original remaining-allowance/scope check reaches the callback. Funded-count errors retain their original order. No heap or persistent metadata is added.
unchanged: Mech source, bytecode, descriptor, Object identity, native Object and code version
Per-operation work formulas, BATCH=1024, fourfold headroom, each selected fuel count and exact debit, error order, scope checks and ledger transaction
All capability, factory, schema, frame, source-visit, sparse-key and other validation checks
Seven workers, complete maps and physical updates; original input and secured launch policies
Default input chunk size 64 KiB; worker ordering, affinity, QoS, power and clock settings
prefix: One excluded warmup and three complete measured processes per subject, kept separate from full-input sessions
diagnostics: Fresh exact-code CPU profiles, whole-process counters, worker lifetimes, peak RSS and binary size remain separate from primary timings.
decision: Retain all earlier factors and the prepared-refill branch. Report both separately balanced sessions and all observations, including uncertain or regressing outcomes. No prediction of a large speedup or Rust parity is made.
